capabilities: Render FEN positions as SVG boards
Add arrows, highlights, and move icons
Navigate PGN moves interactively with a move list
Open positions on the Lichess analysis board
extras: Annotation syntax and PGN rendering are labeled beta/experimental and may change in future versions. SVG pieces are CC BY-SA 3.0, adapted from Cburnett's work by jurgenwesterhof via Wikimedia Commons.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display chess positions or games as visual diagrams inside notes.

relations.evidence: If you want a more fully featured interactive chess plugin, I recommend Chesser.
Right-click any board to open its position in the Lichess analysis board.

summary: Renders chess FEN positions and PGN games as SVG chessboard diagrams in note preview, with optional annotations and interactive navigation.
